title: TargetMap
description: A named map of automation target selectors used by a script to locate UI elements, URLs, commands, or data regions. Each entry is immutable at runtime; no executable script content is permitted in the value field.

targets.description: A map of logical target names to their selector definitions. Keys are stable identifiers referenced by steps via selectorRef.

TargetDefinition.title: TargetDefinition
TargetDefinition.description: Defines how to locate a single automation target. The value field must contain a literal selector expression and must not contain executable script content.

selectorRef.description: The logical name of this target, used by steps to reference it. Must match the map key for cross-validation purposes.

selectorType.description: The mechanism used to locate the target element or resource.

value.description: The literal selector expression for this target. Must not contain executable script content. For css/xpath/uia this is the selector string; for command, the executable path and static arguments; for url, the literal URL; for regex, the pattern.
